### Devotional: Numbers 8
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/numbers-8-psalm-44-song-of-songs-6-hebrews-6/
Passage: Numbers 8:5-19
Points:
- God established cleansing rites to consecrate the Levites before they undertook tabernacle duties.
- Claiming the Levites in exchange for the firstborn spared at Passover, God took them as His special possession.
- Having claimed them for Himself, God gave them back as gifts to Aaron and the community to minister safely near the sanctuary.
- Under the new covenant, Christ similarly redeems believers and distributes them as gifts to build up the church.
- Serving God's people as Christ's redeemed captives grants immense dignity to every form of Christian service.
